events.label: founding
events.text: Open Knowledge Foundation was founded by Rufus Pollock.

evidence.quote: It was founded by Rufus Pollock on 20 May 2004

events.label: launch
events.text: Open Knowledge Foundation was launched in Cambridge, UK.

evidence.quote: launched on 24 May 2004 in Cambridge , UK

events.label: event
events.text: Began holding the Open Knowledge Conference (OKCon), held occasionally.

evidence.quote: Its premier event is the Open Knowledge Conference ( OKCon ) , which has been held occasionally since 2007

evidence.quote: In 2013 OKF obtained sponsorship from CCIA for 3 fellowships
